expectations.text: B1: Handles an unlisted topic via the generic milestone method without dumping code
expectations.evidence: Agent notes 'No spreadsheet entry exists in the upstream catalog ... so the misc track's generic milestone frame applies', then proposes a 7-milestone plan (scope/skeleton → tokenizer → parser → evaluator → dependency graph → edge cases → parity) and asks scoping questions; FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0) and SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0) confirm no code was dumped.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: The reply ends with 'Once you confirm, I'll scaffold the skeleton and give you the first TODO list' — the only 'check' offered is a future definition-of-done sentence ('editing any cell in a 10×10 sheet ... prints correct values ... and #CIRC!'), with no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour from running anything.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions cell formula parsing and dependency graph / recalculation order
expectations.evidence: 'a formula interpreter (=SUM(A1:A3)*2 → value), and a dependency graph that figures out which cells must recompute when one changes, in the right order, detecting cycles'; milestones list '2. Cell model + formula tokenizer', '3. Parser → AST with correct precedence (1+2*3 parses as 1+(2*3))', '5. Dependency graph — topological recompute, cycle detection → #CIRC!'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); OTHER TOOL CALLS are only reads inside the workspace ('.agents/skills/build-your-own-x/skills/misc/references/tutorials.md', '.agents/skills/build-your-own-x/skills/programming-language/SKILL.md'); no install command appears anywhere.
